name: Alisina Yousufi
headline: Automotive Parts & E-commerce
intro: I am an Automotive Parts Inventory & E-commerce Coordinator working remotely for Absolute Auto Parts, an Australian company. I maintain accurate parts inventory in Pinnacle, create and manage listings on Facebook Marketplace and Gumtree, and update product details, photos, and prices. My responsibilities also include researching automotive parts and vehicle compatibility, determining product prices, and correcting invoices in Zoho CRM.

entries.title: Bachelor of Business Administration
entries.description: I am currently studying for a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) at the University of the People (UoPeople) and am in my first semester. I have received a scholarship to support my studies and am developing my knowledge and skills in business, management, and entrepreneurship.

entries.title: Automotive Parts Inventory
entries.description:
Responsibilities:
- Maintain automotive parts inventory in the Pinnacle system.
- Identify and select the correct IC descriptions.
- Research market prices and set competitive prices.
- Find and verify OEM part numbers.
- Upload vehicle and parts photos.

entries.title: E-commerce & Online Product Listing
entries.description:
Responsibilities:
- Create and manage automotive parts listings.
- Write clear and accurate product descriptions.
- Upload photos and update prices and product details.
